act_info.act_name: Early Afternoon Auto Rebate Rush July

buttons.name: Win Free Dinos - Join Family Now

textContent.value: Join us for our Early Afternoon Auto Rebate Rush, meet other hosts, and get yourself rewarded.⚡
⏰ Event run time: 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM PST.
First come, First serve! The first 2,000 hosts complete the task will get reward!!!

lv.1 - if 5,000 beans received, get 3,500 beans reward 

lv.2 - if 10,000 beans received, get 2,500 extra beans reward 

lv.3 - if 20,000 beans received, get 4,000 extra beans reward 

lv.4 - if 30,000 beans received, get 6,500 extra beans reward

lv.5 - if 40,000 beans received, get 5,000 extra beans reward

The maximum reward you can receive is 26,500 beans
Go live in Solo or Multiguest Room ( as host )at least 20 mins within the hour, you can do PK and different livestreaming formats you like!

textContent.value: -We will conduct an audit on Overseas beans (beans received outside of the US/CA region); if the proportion of Overseas beans exceeds 20% of the total beans received, no rewards will be issued 🌍
-Go live for at least 20 mins is required 🕘
- Please do not choose the same time as your other Power Rebate events, otherwise we will only launch the higher reward 🔝
